prompt.project_info: Create a cinematic dark-western portrait of a fictional adult model in a grassy field at night with a calm horse and controlled firelight.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional woman seated on a metal stool, fitted dark jacket, black trousers and leather boots, confident calm expression, loosely holding horse reins in one hand; a powerful brown horse stands safely behind in shadow.
prompt.composition_elements: Night field, controlled circular fire feature at a safe distance, smoke, sparks and embers, horse behind subject, centered editorial portrait, no watermark or branding.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic firelight on face and outfit, cool moonlit fill, shallow depth of field, dark cinematic grading, realistic grass, smoke, leather and horse texture.
prompt.technical_specs: 8K ultra-detailed editorial photography, realistic anatomy and hands, safe controlled flames, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Cinematic dark-western fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman seated on a metal stool in a grassy field at night, fitted dark jacket, black trousers, leather boots, calmly holding loose horse reins, a powerful brown horse safely standing behind in shadow, controlled fire ring at a safe distance, sparks and embers, cool night fill, dramatic firelight, smoke, shallow depth of field, realistic texture, no watermark or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, unsafe fire, horse distress, tight reins, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, watermark, logo, text, plastic skin, extra fingers, deformed, graphic injury

assets.name: dark cowgirl campfire reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Preserve dark jacket, stool, horse, field, fire ring, smoke, embers and western mood; keep identity and exact horse details replaceable.
